name: Talking-Head B-roll (merged reference profile)
description: Editing-style preset for the video agent's director LLM. Derived from teardown of two reference videos (oaNDqWTaQ6w, F31ug-Q-jCg). Encodes the consistent style DNA plus tunable knobs. The director reads this to produce an edit decision list; FFmpeg executes it deterministically.

broll.notes: Real footage carries the video (Storyblocks first). Stills/graphics fill the rest and are always animated. AI video gen is a last resort, used sparingly.

transitions.audio_continuity: voiceover runs uninterrupted under all visual cuts

stat_callouts.trigger: on spoken number, price, or key keyword

look.avatar_framing: medium close-up, chest-up, centered or slightly left, soft key light
look.broll_framing: mix of extreme close-ups and wide establishing shots

split_screen.description: Allow speaker-on-one-third + reference-imagery layouts (heavy in F31ug-Q-jCg, occasional in oaNDqWTaQ6w).

color_grade.description: Per-project grade; not baked into the base style.
